description.en: The name of the document collection to be deleted.

description.zh:
实例ID。

> 您可以调用[DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~)接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID。
description.en:
Instance ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) API to view details of all AnalyticDB PostgreSQL instances in the target region, including the instance ID.

description.zh:
命名空间，默认为public。

> 您可以通过[CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~)接口创建，通过[ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~)接口查看列表。
description.en:
The name of the namespace. Default value: public.

>  You can call the [CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~) operation to create a namespace and call the [ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~) operation to query a list of namespaces.

description.zh:
命名空间对应的密码。

> 本值为[CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~)接口指定。
description.en:
Password for the namespace.

> This value is specified by the [CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~) API.
The ID of the region where the instance is located.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb delete-document-collection --db-instance-id gp-xxxxxxxxx --namespace mynamespace --collection document --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --namespace-password testpassword --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gpdb DeleteDocumentCollection --region cn-hangzhou --DBInstanceId 'gp-xxxxxxxxx' --Collection document --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --NamespacePassword testpassword --Namespace mynamespace
